bookmarkGatewayErrNameForbidden.message: This header can't be set here. The browser controls it, or the extension already sends it (for example Authorization or Cookie).

bookmarkGatewayErrDuplicate.message: Each header name can be used only once (letter case is ignored).

bookmarkGatewayErrValue.message: Enter a value of up to 2048 printable ASCII characters, without quotation marks (") or backslashes (\).

bookmarkGatewayErrTooLong.message: The headers are too long. Names and values can total at most 4096 characters.

bookmarkConnectFailed.message: Connection failed. Check the server URL, token and site permission.

bookmarkInvalidConfig.message: Enter a valid server URL and API token.

bookmarkUrlInvalid.message: Enter an https:// server address with no username, password, query or fragment. HTTP is allowed only for localhost.

bookmarkPermissionDenied.message: Allow access to this server in Settings, then reconnect.

bookmarkKarakeepHint.message: Read Later uses a dedicated private list. Marking a bookmark as read removes it from that list. Archiving in the service is unchanged.

bookmarkPartialSave.message: The bookmark may be saved, but some changes failed. Open Edit to check and save again.

bookmarkErrGatewayRedirect.message: The server redirected the request. Common causes: a sign-in gateway such as Cloudflare Access, or a wrong URL. Add a service token under Access gateway, or allow the API path in the gateway.

bookmarkErrGatewayChallenge.message: A security check (bot challenge) blocked the request. Cloudflare security rules are a common cause; allow the API path there.

bookmarkErrGatewayBasic.message: A proxy in front of the server asks for a username and password (Basic). That can't be combined with the bookmark token, so allow the API path in the proxy.

bookmarkErrGatewayDenied.message: A gateway in front of the server refused the request. Check the credentials under Access gateway and that its policy allows them. With Cloudflare, the policy action must be Service Auth.

bookmarkErrNotApi.message: The server returned a web page, not API data. Check that the URL points to Karakeep or linkding itself.

bookmarkErrAuth.message: The server rejected the API token. Check the token in Settings, then reconnect.

bookmarkConnectErrAuth.message: The server rejected the API token. Check the token above, then connect again.

backupAdoptLibrary.message: This personal library is empty. Restoring vocabulary or highlights will adopt the backup’s library so its existing Drive data remains available.
